author: David LaPorte
releaseNotes: The driver now logs in again only when its session expires or is rejected, instead of after every error (an outage used to mean a failed login on every poll). Initialize fetches data right away, a station without wired sensors no longer stops a poll partway, and lightningActive clears when its window ends. New healthStatus attribute, which also goes offline when the station hasn't reported to myAcuRite for 2 hours. Outages are logged once, with an hourly reminder and a recovery line. Debug logging now turns itself off after 30 minutes, and a new descriptionText logging option (on by default) logs value changes. After updating, click Initialize on the device. Requires Hubitat 2.2.9+.
